sentences.text:
Mhantesh Basavraj Bhavi vs State Of Maharashtra on 21
December, 2023

Author: N.J.Jamadar
Bench: N.J.Jamadar
 906 aba 3581 of 2023.
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction
 Anticipatory Bail Application No.3581 Of 2023
Mhantesh Basavraj Bhavi ... Applicant
 versus
The State of Maharashtra ... Respondent
Sumit Kothari, for Applicant.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Smt. Ashwini Takalkar, App for State.
Heard the learned Counsel for the parties.

2. This is an application for pre-arrest bail in connection with C.R.No.460 of 2023 registered with
Akkalkot North Police Station for the offences punishable under Sections 328, 188, 272 and 273 of
the Indian Penal Code and Sections 26(2)(i), 26(2)(v), 26(2)(ii), 27(3)(e) and 59 of the Food Safety
and Standards Act, 2006.

3. The applicant apprehends arrest in connection with the aforesaid crime as the co-accused in
whose possession the contraband articles - Gutakha Pan masala, has been seized, has named the
applicant as the alleged supplier of the contraband articles.

4. In identical matters, this Court has granted interim relief and posted the matters for
consideration on 30 January 2024 as the question of applicability of Section 328 of the Penal Code
in a case of the present nature awaits decision of the 906 aba 3581 of 2023.doc Supreme Court.

5.  In view of the above, in the event of arrest of the applicant in CR No.289 of 2022, registered with Akkalkot North Police Station, the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a PR Bond in the sum of Rs.30,000/- with one or two sureties in the like amount.
